notes_for_editor: History comes from one compiled page (Forest Lookouts) that quotes a 1939 fire report, a History of the Bighorn National Forest, a CCC inspection memo and regional forester memos. Those primary documents were not checked directly. The 1939 fire refers to the Hunter Mesa LO location before the 1940 tower, so the site may have been in use before the tower; the sources do not say. Distance: firelookout.com says 10 miles west of Buffalo; a Living New Deal page, which could not be fetched, is reported to give 12.75 miles, so it is not cited. Living New Deal also says it is unsure the structure still stands; that could not be checked. Removal date not found. The record says kind tower and that matches. Access level unknown.
